sourceOfTruth: one-fuzhu published schema-v3 contract; HarmonyOS is the behavior baseline

riveInstanceReferences.migration: Use retained instance references for list/nested edits; JSON descriptor bindings only explicitly replace the whole value.
riveInstanceReferences.notificationTiming: Official state-machine/artboard advance and render message processing; not setter echo or polling.

availability.oldClientPolicy: Cloud rules do not install native APIs; check method presence and capability flags. Missing methods or false flags must not be simulated.

receivers.artboardResource: assets.artboard result, also has resource methods
receivers.file: qu.rive.files.open or worker.open result; has assets receiver

instanceSource.names: Use actual file metadata; do not invent names.

fileSource.urlPolicy: No automatic URL fetching. Use declared qu.network APIs then pass the owned resource token or bytes.
fileSource.permissions: Same script/package resource ownership and network domain permissions as existing resource readers.

fileOptions.withWorker: Requires a live Worker reference from the same script. enableGPUCanvas must be omitted.

fit.scaleFactor: Positive finite number for layout; omitted defaults follow the current SDK/host.

frameRate.range: minimum >= 0, maximum > 0, minimum <= maximum, preferred when supplied is within range; native display caps apply.
frameRate.default: Native platform policy; Android restores the application 60 fps cap.
frameRate.scope: Current displayed player only; independent objects advance explicitly.

volume.scope: The addressed artboard; not a per-file global mixer.

parameters.color: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; native Rive clear color, not an overlay.

advance.independentStateMachine: No autoplay clock is created; advance explicitly.

pointer.coordinates: Physical pixels of the Rive viewport, not screen logical coordinates.
pointer.viewport: width and height positive; optional fit/alignment/scaleFactor use addressed graph configuration.

keyInput.keyAndModifiers: Official unsigned key/modifier values; no synthetic platform key remapping.
keyInput.note: The shipped current-player and independent-object adapters use different boolean option names. Use the receiver-specific fields; do not mix them.

semanticsDrain.dimensions: Positive viewport dimensions; enable before advance/drain/observe.
semanticsDrain.nodeID: Use real nodes from the official semantics event payload, not guessed IDs.

assetDecode.deferredDecode: GPU Canvas may return recorded/deferred resources. A handle alone does not prove complete image decoding.
assetDecode.audio: Register as an out-of-band asset; there is no RVMI Audio property.
assetDecode.systemFont: Apple only: name defaults to empty, size defaults to 16.
assetDecode.registration: Global names are Worker-scoped. close releases the script resource reference and does not implicitly unregister the name.

result.pixels: Uint8Array, width * height * 4 bytes when not skipped

render.skip: Only {skipped:true}; never return a fabricated cached frame.
render.output: Raw native pixels, not PNG/JPEG or a screen capture; channel order is determined by format.

nativeBackend.harmony: Official RiveRenderer/CommandQueue, adapter Vulkan offscreen readback

events.listenerReturns: Synchronous cancel function; callbacks are native notifications, not setter echoes.
events.settled: Current state machine is settled, not a generic animation-finished event.
events.focusPayload: Official focus state, including focused and expectsKeyboardInput when supplied by SDK.
events.runtimeMessagePayload: Harmony: {tag, payload:number[]} from native runtime message bytes.
events.timing: Native advance/render/lifecycle message processing. Independent graphs require explicit enable/advance/drain as applicable; observation does not run a clock or fabricate initial snapshots.

ownership.referenceIdentity: Official SDK instance/resource identity; equals uses native identity. No JSON cloning, same-name matching or field-content matching.
ownership.currentPlayer: Graph-scoped handles and subscriptions become invalid on graph replacement or script stop.
ownership.independentObjects: Script-scoped and independent of current player replacement; file close invalidates its scoped handles and listeners.
ownership.sameWorkerOnly: Cross-file native VMI and decoded resource references are accepted only within one Worker and script; model/property compatibility remains an SDK decision.
ownership.workerClose: Releases the JS Worker owner and forbids new opens; already-open files retain the Worker until they close.
ownership.fileClose: Closes only this file, not other files sharing the Worker.
ownership.instanceClose: Releases this script handle; does not remove a list element or clear a still-bound native instance.
ownership.importFailure: A failed file import must not terminate other files on the Worker.
ownership.scriptStop: Releases objects and subscriptions owned by this script.
ownership.globals: get returns only explicitly retained global overrides. Default SDK global instances are not synthesized; Apple global clear remains unavailable.

integration.directJS: Direct SDK instance operations need no same-named QVMI fields.
integration.manifestBindings: Keep declarative bindings for shared QVMI values; scalar directions remain as declared.
integration.dynamicJSBindings: Keep JS reads/observations of QVMI and explicit operations on genuine RVMI references.
integration.sharedUI: Resource package UI continues to use its owner-scoped QVMI values.
integration.writes: QVMI writes obey existing declarations, ownership and writable permissions; no automatic RVMI backflow. Scripts may explicitly publish an observed Rive property into a writable field they own.
integration.containerPolicy: List is a collection of native ViewModelInstance references. No whole-JSON automatic round trip or simulated container observation.
